title: Substation event-log event
description: One newline-delimited JSON (.jsonl) protocol event: the normalized envelope (PRD.md §6.3) plus a per-protocol `detail` object modeled on ICSNPP fields. One event per line; this schema validates a single line/object. Modbus `detail` is FROZEN against ICSNPP modbus_detailed.log (docs/spikes/01-icsnpp-modbus-fields.md); DNP3 `detail` is FROZEN against Zeek dnp3.log + ICSNPP dnp3_control.log/dnp3_objects.log (docs/spikes/04-icsnpp-dnp3-fields.md); S7 `detail` is FROZEN against ICSNPP s7comm.log + cotp.log/s7comm_read_szl.log/s7comm_upload_download.log/s7comm_plus.log (docs/spikes/06-icsnpp-s7comm-fields.md).

ts.description: Event timestamp as Unix epoch seconds (Zeek `ts`).

is_orig.description: ICSNPP `is_orig`: true when this event originated from the connection originator (request side).

direction.description: Normalized direction derived from is_orig: request when true, response when false.

func_code.description: Raw one-byte function/command code. Modbus exception responses carry function_code | 0x80.

func_name.description: Decoded, normalized function name. For Modbus: Zeek `Modbus::function_codes[func_code]`, with an `_EXCEPTION` suffix on exception responses.

action_class.description: Normalized verb that drives cross-protocol logic (X1) and shared Sigma rules. See docs/schema.md for the Modbus func -> action_class mapping.

is_exception.description: True when this event is an error/exception (Modbus: func_name ends in _EXCEPTION / detail.exception_code present).

error.description: Decoded exception/error name when is_exception is true (Modbus mirrors detail.exception_code, e.g. ILLEGAL_FUNCTION); null or absent otherwise.

detail.description: Per-protocol detail object mirroring ICSNPP fields. Constrained per `proto` below.

allOf.$comment: Direction is derived from is_orig, not free — enforce the invariant (true -> request, false -> response) so an event cannot pass the gate while classifying endpoints inconsistently.
A Modbus exception must carry the decoded exception name: error mirrors detail.exception_code and drives M2, so neither may be absent/null on an exception event.

conn.description: Zeek conn tuple (ICSNPP `id`). Endpoints are originator/responder, not per-direction source/destination; derive source/destination through is_orig (spike 01).

modbus_detail.description: Modbus detail modeled on ICSNPP modbus_detailed.log (Modbus_Detailed record in icsnpp-modbus scripts/main.zeek). All fields optional, mirroring Zeek's optional record fields. Sub-shapes for mask-write (0x16), read/write-multiple (0x17) and read-device-identification (0x2B) are pulled in when those function codes appear.

unit.description: Modbus unit identifier (`unit`). NB: ICSNPP README spells this `uint` for some logs; code/`main.zeek` says `unit` — code wins (spike 01).

func.description: ICSNPP `func` (Zeek function name); mirrors envelope func_name.

address.description: Starting address of the value(s) field (`address`).

quantity.description: Number of coils / discrete inputs / registers (`quantity`).

modbus_detailed_link_id.description: Links this row to the mask-write / read-write-multiple / read-device-id extended logs (`modbus_detailed_link_id`).

exception_code.description: Exception name on an exception response (`exception_code`). Drives envelope is_exception/error and M2.

mei_type.description: MEI type for encapsulated interface transport (`mei_type`).

modbus_mask_write.description: ICSNPP modbus_mask_write_register.log fields specific to MASK_WRITE_REGISTER (func 0x16); `address` is carried on the parent detail.

modbus_read_write_multiple.description: ICSNPP modbus_read_write_multiple_registers.log fields specific to READ_WRITE_MULTIPLE_REGISTERS (func 0x17).

dnp3_detail.description: DNP3 detail modeled on Zeek base dnp3.log (DNP3::Info) plus ICSNPP dnp3_control.log / dnp3_objects.log (icsnpp-dnp3 scripts/main.zeek; docs/spikes/04-icsnpp-dnp3-fields.md). All fields optional, mirroring Zeek/ICSNPP optional record fields. control (CROB/PCB) and objects (object-header) sub-shapes are pulled in for SELECT/OPERATE and READ/RESPONSE messages respectively.

fc_request.description: Request function name (dnp3.log fc_request = DNP3::function_codes[fc]); mirrors envelope func_name on requests.

fc_reply.description: Reply function name (dnp3.log fc_reply); mirrors envelope func_name on responses (RESPONSE / UNSOLICITED_RESPONSE).

dnp3_control.description: ICSNPP dnp3_control.log fields (Control record) for SELECT/OPERATE Control-Relay-Output-Block / Pattern-Control-Block commands. is_orig and source_*/destination_* are not duplicated here — the envelope conn + is_orig carry them (spike 04).

function_code.description: Function code string for this control row (function_code: SELECT/OPERATE/RESPONSE).

operation_type.description: Nul, Pulse_On, Pulse_Off, Latch_On, or Latch_Off (operation_type).

status_code.description: Status code string on a RESPONSE (status_code).

dnp3_objects.description: ICSNPP dnp3_objects.log fields (Objects record) for READ/RESPONSE object headers. On a READ request only function_code + object_type are populated; range/count are populated on the RESPONSE (spike 04).

function_code.description: Function code string for this object row (function_code: READ/RESPONSE).

modbus_read_device_identification.description: ICSNPP modbus_read_device_identification.log fields specific to READ_DEVICE_IDENTIFICATION (func 0x2B / MEI 14; Zeek >= 6.1).

s7comm_detail.description: S7 detail modeled on ICSNPP s7comm.log (S7COMM record in icsnpp-s7comm scripts/icsnpp/s7comm/main.zeek; docs/spikes/06-icsnpp-s7comm-fields.md). All fields optional, mirroring the parser's optional record fields. The cotp / read_szl / upload_download / plus sub-objects mirror cotp.log / s7comm_read_szl.log / s7comm_upload_download.log / s7comm_plus.log and are pulled in for the matching message type. function_code/subfunction_code/error_code are logged by ICSNPP as hex strings; counts are integers.

rosctr_code.description: Remote Operating Service Control code (s7comm.log rosctr_code).

rosctr_name.description: ROSCTR name (rosctr_types): Job-Request / ACK / ACK-Data / User-Data.

function_code.description: Parameter function code, hex string (function_code, e.g. 0x05).

subfunction_code.description: User-Data subfunction code (hex string) or PLC-control service string (subfunction_code).

subfunction_name.description: User-Data subfunction name or PLC-control service name (subfunction_name).

error_class.description: Error class name (s7comm_error_class[error_class]); present on ACK/ACK-Data with an error.

error_code.description: Error code within the error class, hex string (error_code).

s7comm_cotp.description: ICSNPP cotp.log fields (COTP record) for a COTP PDU. pdu_code is the PDU-type high nibble as a hex string; pdu_name is cotp_pdu_types[pdu].

pdu_code.description: COTP PDU type code, hex string (pdu_code, e.g. 0x0e).

pdu_name.description: COTP PDU type name (pdu_name, e.g. 'CR Connection Request').

s7comm_read_szl.description: ICSNPP s7comm_read_szl.log fields (S7COMM_READ_SZL record) for the Read-SZL function. szl_id/szl_index/return_code are hex strings; szl_id_name = s7comm_szl_id[szl_id & 0xff].

szl_id_name.description: Meaning of the SZL ID (szl_id_name, e.g. 'Module identification').

return_code_name.description: Meaning of the return code (return_code_name, e.g. 'Success').

s7comm_upload_download.description: ICSNPP s7comm_upload_download.log fields (S7COMM_UPLOAD_DOWNLOAD record) for the six program/block transfer functions. NB the README lists function_code/function_status as count, but the record logs function_name/function_status as strings — code wins (spike 06).

blocklength.description: Length of the block to upload/download (blocklength).

filename.description: Filename of the block to upload/download (filename).

s7comm_plus.description: ICSNPP s7comm_plus.log fields (S7COMM_PLUS record) for an S7comm-plus PDU. opcode/function_code are hex strings; opcode_name = s7comm_plus_opcodes[opcode]; function_name = s7comm_plus_functions[function_code].

function_code.description: Opcode function code, hex string (function_code, e.g. 0x04bb).
